crossRefs.note: It shall be a Sabbath of solemn rest for you, and you shall deny yourselves. In the ninth day of the month at evening…
but in the seventh year there shall be a Sabbath of solemn rest for the land, a Sabbath to Yahweh. You shall not sow…
Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day is a Sabbath of solemn rest, holy to Yahweh. Whoever does any work…
‘Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day there shall be a holy day for you, a Sabbath of solemn rest to…

translations.web: It is a Sabbath of solemn rest to you, and you shall afflict your souls. It is a statute forever.
translations.bsb: It is a Sabbath of complete rest for you, that you may humble yourselves; it is a permanent statute.
translations.kjv: It shall be a sabbath of rest unto you, and ye shall afflict your souls, by a statute for ever.
translations.asv: It is a sabbath of solemn rest unto you, and ye shall afflict your souls; it is a statute for ever.
